evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Rep said: 'I'm gonna ask you questions Michael, regarding the move and this might take five to ten minutes of your time.' This is a shortened version of the time-boxed + dependable quote promise; no explicit wait for a yes before continuing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Pickup: '4905. Jue Street, Austin, 78751' | Moving day: 'October 21st' | Route: Austin to Austin (8121 Greensville Drive) | Size: '1200 square feet one story house with how many bedrooms please? There are two bedrooms'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Rep asked: 'Alright. Before I disclose the pricing and the estimate, do you have any concerns about the moving process?' — This came after substantial logistics probing, not before.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised: box delivery timing and packing expectations. Rep clarified once ('would you like to avail boxes from us or...') but did not probe deeper into underlying concerns; moved directly to explaining packing service options.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: Rep did not reflect back or summarize the customer's stated concern about box delivery and packing timing.
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type: house | Floor/stories: 1 story (pickup), 2 story (delivery) | Bedrooms: 2 (pickup), 4 (delivery) | Rooms: living, entertainment, dining, kitchen (pickup); 4 bedrooms (delivery) | Parking: street parking both locations | Access concerns: porch with 3–4 steps (pickup), attached garage (delivery) | Special items: workout equipment, dining table (glass top, disassembles), TV console, couches, bed, crib, dressers, outdoor grill (Green Egg with removable components), outdoor furniture set (sofa, chairs, tables, umbrellas), lawn equipment (electric mower, blower, weed eater), outdoor trunk (~200 lbs). All seven elements covered or exceeded.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Rep offered: 'Because sir we also offer packing and moving. So if you're gonna avail packing then we will bring the boxes to you and pack everything.' Customer accepted: 'Yeah, I'd like to get a quote on the, on the help to pack everything up.'
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Rep stated: 'for a home your size, 1200 square feet we normally see 45 to 55 boxes. Do you think you would fall within that range?' Customer: 'That feels about right, yeah.'
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask_for_booking: Rep said: 'Okay on. Michael I'll be sending you that. There is a confirmed booking for October 20th which is Tuesday to do the full packing, services and October 21st for the booth' — but the customer had already committed ('Yes please') to securing the schedule. The ask was effectively embedded in the workflow, not a standalone 'Would you like our help?' ask.
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_scheduled: Rep confirmed: 'This Tuesday coming October 6th?' at '3:00 PM' for virtual walkthrough. Customer agreed. Link and reminder text promised. This is a clean routing to a scheduled walkthrough for a packing+move job (1200 sq ft pickup, 2600 sq ft delivery with outdoor items and special requirements).

top_strength: Exceptional logistics discovery—the rep gathered all seven required detail categories (property type, stories, rooms, parking, access concerns, special items, and weight-sensitive items) systematically and noted client-specific constraints (bike lane, driveway limitations, garage access, Green Egg prep requirements) that will materially improve the actual move estimate.
coaching_note: Move 'their agenda' question earlier (before probing starts, not after), and when a concern is raised, dig at least one layer deeper—ask 'tell me more about that' rather than clarifying the service offering and moving on.
